name: Crate of Horseshoes
label: Item
description: In Elwynn, fifty iron horseshoes are bound for Lakeshire.
intro: In Elwynn, fifty iron horseshoes are bound for Lakeshire.

p: Smith Argus forged fifty fresh horseshoes in Goldshire, then packed the crate and hammered it shut. Verner Osgood commissioned them for Lakeshire, where constant pressure from gnolls and orcs leaves local craftsmen reliant on Elwynn for essential metal goods. The delivery answers Verner's desperate need for equipment, and Argus includes a stern bill of sale so the Redridge craftsman knows frontier survival comes at a steep price.
